facts.fact: Minister Samuel Nartey George told the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference that Ghana is building a National AI Compute Centre to support research, innovation and enterprise.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations

facts.fact: Minister Samuel Nartey George said Ghana is completing 2,016 rural telephony sites and upgrading rural 2G and 3G sites to 4G/5G-ready, under the New Economy Policy.
Minister Samuel Nartey George said Ghana is training One Million Coders, giving no count trained or locations.
Minister Samuel Nartey George stated that Ghana chairs the African Union Specialised Technical Committee on Communication and ICT.
